title: Operating Portal Module Inventory Phase 1
notes: Authoritative audit of all 30 operating portal modules with route paths and operational roles.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Diem Danh (Attendance)
notes: Comprehensive functional specification for daily per-class check-in/out, temperature, health notes, and authorized pickup tracking.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Hoat Dong (Daily Activities)
notes: Daily activity posts, media attachments, approval workflow, and parent engagement metrics.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Thu Vien (Media Library & Face ID)
notes: Class photo/video albums, automated aggregation from activities/attendance, and facial recognition student tagging.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Trao Doi (Parent Messaging)
notes: Real-time and asynchronous messaging threads between school/teachers and parents, custom student groups, and class broadcasts.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Bao Cao Diem Danh
notes: Monthly attendance calendar, excused vs unexcused adjustments, and late pickup penalty calculation.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Bao Cao Mo Rong
notes: Configurable report generation engine with export filters by grade, class, date range, and student status.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Thoi Khoa Bieu (Timetable)
notes: Weekly timetable matrix by class, subject periods, teacher assignment, and versioned parent broadcast.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Bai Tap (Homework)
notes: Homework distribution per class/subject, deadline controls, attachment management, and student submission tracking.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Diem & Danh Gia (Gradebook)
notes: Grade evaluation sheets, regular, midterm, and semester grading rubrics browsable by grade level, class, and subject.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Hoc Phi (Tuition & Invoicing)
notes: Per-student billing invoices, meal fee deductions based on attendance, dynamic QR codes, payment status tracking, and receipt history.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Khoan Phi (Fee Catalog)
notes: Master catalog of school fee items, billing periods, required vs optional fees, and calculation formulas.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Quan Ly Hoc Phi (Class Fee Schedules)
notes: Assignment of fee catalog items and specific price overrides to classes, student cohorts, and academic years.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Khoan Chi (Disbursements & Expenses)
notes: Expense vouchers, categorized disbursements, receipt evidence, approval lifecycle, and voucher cancellation flows.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Doi Soat (Payment Reconciliation)
notes: Reconciliation sessions of online transactions, gateway settlement tracking, fee counts, and discrepancy audit.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Bao Cao Hoc Phi (Collection Reports)
notes: Class-level and school-wide fee collection rate analytics, tracking paid, partially paid, and unpaid rosters.

title: ECO Design System 1.0 Specification
notes: Design tokens, color palettes (#FEC020, #0070CE), typography scales, and component library primitives.

title: School Operating Portal Architectural Spec & Project Memory
notes: Defines multi-tenant routing, Next.js Pages Router, Redux, Laravel Sanctum token auth, and Cloud Run + OpenResty topology.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Hoc Sinh (Student Management)
notes: Authoritative functional specification for student records, enrollment, class/year transfers, tuition overrides, and multi-parent contacts.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Giao Vien (Teacher & Staff Directory)
notes: Specification for teacher directory, homeroom and subject class assignments, invitation dispatch, content moderation tiers, and credentials.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Lop Hoc (Class Management)
notes: Specification for curricular and extracurricular class partitioning, teacher homeroom assignment, student rosters, and deletion safety guards.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Mon Hoc (Subject Catalog)
notes: Catalog of subjects across 4 educational levels (TH, THCS, THPT, GDTX), evaluation term matrices, and teaching teacher assignment.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Khoi Lop (Grade Level Hierarchy)
notes: Grade level hierarchy across 4 educational levels, class and student aggregated headcounts, and reactive search resolution.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Bang Thong Tin (Announcement Board)
notes: Specification for drafting, scheduling, broadcasting, previewing, and auditing school-wide and class-level announcements.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Binh Chon (Polls & Surveys)
notes: Specification for multi-option surveys, audience targeting, real-time result aggregation with progress/pie charts, and vote change histories.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Thuc Don (Weekly Meal Menus)
notes: Specification for grid-based and file-based weekly menus, class overrides with school-wide fallback, and GTIN/stamp food traceability.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Diem Danh NV (Staff Attendance)
notes: Specification for daily rapid staff check-in/out, 45-day retroactive editing window, mutual exclusivity of absent markings, and counter suppression on search.

title: PRD & Test Cases: So Tay PH (Parent Handbook)
notes: Specification for 2-tier category accordion hierarchy, rich-text article drafting, publishing/hiding workflows, and cascading deletion safeguards.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Gop Y (Parent Feedback & Inquiries)
notes: Specification for parent feedback inbox, ticket lifecycle (new, processing, completed, reopened), priority ratings, handler assignments, and 2-way discussion threads.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Lich Su Kien (Event & Holiday Calendar)
notes: Specification for school event and holiday calendar across 3 display topologies (Year, Month, Event list), 3 semantic event categories, and multi-year navigation.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Nam Hoc (Academic Years & Terms)
notes: Specification for defining academic years and terms, automated system-date current year badge resolution, and cross-module year filter feeding.

title: User Requirement Brief & Flow Diagram: Thiet Lap Mien Giam Hoc Phi (Tuition & Fee Discount Management)
notes: Specification for tuition exemption and discount policies under Finance module: % or fixed amount, fee catalog binding, student or class multi-selection, temporal validity, auto-apply toggle on invoice creation, and Excel export.

title: PRD & Architecture: Finance Tuition Billing & Invoicing Engine
notes: Specification for student invoice line items, attendance meal deduction calculations, draft invoice editing, and itemized discount deductions.

title: Decree 81/2021/ND-CP: Mechanism for Tuition Fee Collection, Exemption, and Reduction Policies in Education
publisher: Government of Vietnam / Ministry of Education and Training (MoET)
notes: Vietnamese statutory requirements on educational fee exemption and reduction categories (policy beneficiaries, disabled students, ethnic minorities, academic scholarships, teacher kin benefits) and institutional recordkeeping.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Cau Hinh - Hoc Phi (Settings Fee Configuration)
notes: Specification for invoice footer notes, Sepay auto payment display, SInvoice configuration, late pickup surcharges, absence meal refund threshold, and reconciliation email recipients.

title: PRD & Test Cases: Cau Hinh - Truong (School Information & Operating Hours)
notes: Specification for school operating hours schedule (Monday through Saturday) referenced read-only in settings fee absence meal refund.

title: Decree 123/2020/ND-CP & Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC: Legal Standards on Electronic Invoices in Vietnam
publisher: Government of Vietnam / Ministry of Finance
notes: Vietnamese statutory requirements on electronic invoices, tax identification numbers, digital certificates, invoice template formats, and serial classifications.

title: User Requirement Document: THIET LAP CO CHE HOAN TIEN AN (Meal Refund Mechanism Specification)
notes: Operational specification for meal refund mechanism: Group A (school holidays/events at 100% fixed) and Group B (student-initiated absences at configurable % for Tien an and Tien an sang), with automated deduction in next month tuition invoice.

title: PRD & Architecture: Finance Invoicing Cycle & Cross-Module Absence Deductions
notes: Specification for next-month billing reconciliation, previous-month absence aggregation, and itemized deduction line item rendering in invoice wizard.

title: Circular 28/2020/TT-BGDDT: Operational & Financial Regulations for Primary & Secondary Boarding Schools
notes: Vietnamese educational standards on boarding meal fee collection, dietary accounting, absence notification deadlines, and parent fee reconciliation.

title: Functional Specification: Lịch Sự Kiện (School Event Calendar)
notes: Comprehensive functional specification for School Event Calendar: 3 view modes (Năm, Tháng, Sự kiện), 3 fixed categories, date spans, inspection modals, and direct inline agenda actions.

title: Operating Portal Module Inventory: Module 58 Lịch Sự Kiện
notes: Inventory record for School Event Calendar under School Administration.

title: Vietnam Labor Code 45/2019/QH14 & MoET Academic Year Directives on School Holidays
notes: Statutory public holidays (Tết, Giỗ Tổ Hùng Vương, 30/4, 1/5, Quốc khánh 2/9) and institutional event planning regulations for schools.

title: Functional Specification: Lớp Học (School Class Management)
notes: Comprehensive functional specification for School Class Management: 2 tabs (Lớp chính khóa & Lớp ngoại khóa), action controls, delete safety rules, teacher assignment, and detail views.

title: Functional Specification: Khối Lớp (School Grade Levels)
notes: Grade levels directory structure across 4 education tiers (Tiểu học, THCS, THPT, GDTX) and class enrollment aggregation.

title: MoET Circular 32/2020/TT-BGDĐT: Charter of Secondary and High Schools (Điều lệ trường THCS, THPT và trường phổ thông có nhiều cấp học)
notes: Article 15 & 16: Class organization, maximum class size thresholds, homeroom teacher legal duties, student records, and grade levels.

title: MoET Decision 4998/QĐ-BGDĐT: Technical Specifications for National Education Database (CSDL Ngành Giáo dục và Đào tạo)
notes: Data standards for class identifiers, academic year mapping, grade codes, and synchronization status with provincial departments of education.

title: Functional Specification: Môn Học (School Subject Management)
notes: Comprehensive functional specification for School Subject Management: 4 educational stages (TH, THCS, THPT, GDTX), subject classifications, evaluation methods across 4 terms, teacher assignment/unassignment governance, and read-only catalog policies.

title: Circular 22/2021/TT-BGDĐT: Regulations on Assessment of Secondary and High School Students (Quy định về đánh giá học sinh THCS và học sinh THPT)
notes: Statutory evaluation standards for THCS and THPT: numerical scoring, descriptive comment evaluation (Nhận xét for Âm nhạc, Mỹ thuật, GDTC, HĐTN-HN), periodic evaluation terms (Giữa kỳ, Cuối kỳ), and GPA summarization.

title: Circular 27/2020/TT-BGDĐT: Regulations on Assessment of Primary School Students (Quy định về đánh giá học sinh tiểu học)
notes: Statutory evaluation standards for Primary (Tiểu học): evaluation levels (Hoàn thành tốt, Hoàn thành, Chưa hoàn thành), formative feedback comments, and periodic scores for specific grades/subjects.

title: Circular 32/2018/TT-BGDĐT: Master General Education Curriculum 2018 (Chương trình Giáo dục phổ thông 2018)
notes: Curricular framework establishing compulsory subjects (Bắt buộc), electives (Tự chọn), career-oriented selectable subjects (Lựa chọn for Grades 10-12), and educational activities across all educational tiers.

title: Circular 28/2020/TT-BGDĐT: Charter of Primary Schools (Điều lệ Trường Tiểu học)
notes: Statutory framework governing primary education, defining Grades 1 to 5, class organization, maximum class size (35 students), and primary teacher assignments.

title: Law on Education 43/2019/QH14: National Educational System (Luật Giáo dục 2019)
notes: Organic legal framework governing the national education structure, establishing educational stages: Primary (5 years, G1-G5), Lower Secondary (4 years, G6-G9), Upper Secondary (3 years, G10-G12), and Continuing Education (GDTX).

title: Functional Specification: Khối Lớp (School Grade Level Management)
notes: Comprehensive functional specification for School Grade Level Management: 4 educational stages (TH, THCS, THPT, GDTX), read-only master catalogs, dynamic class/student rollups, client-side accent-insensitive search, and grade detail views with direct operational links.

title: Functional Specification: Bảng Thông Tin (School Announcements & Information Board)
notes: Comprehensive functional specification for School Announcement Board: 3 lifecycle states (Bản nháp, Chưa gửi, Đã gửi), 5 recipient targets, 6 category types, 3 transmission channels, draft-only editing, interactive preview modal, and irrevocable email warning on deletion.

title: Circular 28/2020/TT-BGDĐT & Circular 32/2020/TT-BGDĐT: Regulations on Educational Information Disclosure and Parent Communication
notes: Statutory requirements for school-to-home communications, mandatory disclosure of academic calendars, meal menus, holiday closures, and emergency parent notifications.

title: Law on Cyber Information Security 86/2015/QH13 & Decree 13/2023/NĐ-CP: Personal Data Protection in Educational Notifications
publisher: National Assembly of Vietnam & Government of Vietnam
notes: Regulatory guidelines on email and notification delivery in educational portals, audit trails for transmitted communications, and privacy boundaries for recipient lists.

title: Functional Specification: Bình Chọn (School Polls, Voting & Surveys)
notes: Comprehensive functional specification for School Polls & Surveys: 3 lifecycle states (Đã tạo, Đã gửi, Đã đóng), decoupled authoring from dispatch, multi-option selection toggle, parental result visibility toggle, live progress bar & pie chart results, student voter rosters by class, and choice revision audit trails.

title: Circular 32/2020/TT-BGDĐT: Charter of Secondary Schools on Parent and Student Feedback Mechanisms
notes: Statutory regulations governing democratic consultative mechanisms in secondary schools, stipulating school-parent surveys on extracurricular activities, canteen quality, uniforms, and educational choices.

title: Law on Cyber Information Security 86/2015/QH13 & Decree 13/2023/NĐ-CP: Personal Data Governance and Integrity in Educational Surveys
publisher: National Assembly of Vietnam & Government of Vietnam
notes: Statutory requirements on data integrity and audit logging for digital polling, voter identity tracking, and confidentiality policies for sensitive institutional surveys.

title: Decision 4998/QĐ-BGDĐT: Digital Transformation Guidelines for K-12 Educational Feedback and Online Operations
notes: Guidelines for online feedback platforms in K-12 schools, ensuring reliable record keeping, real-time result aggregation, and accessible participation across school cohorts.

title: Functional Specification: Điểm Danh NV (School Staff Attendance & Daily Timekeeping)
notes: Comprehensive functional specification for School Staff Attendance: daily presence tracking, 1-click Check-in/Check-out, inline time editing with DD-01 rollback, dedicated absence modal with DD-03 warning, 45-day retrospective lock, multi-role badging, and search-responsive KPI display.

title: Labor Code 45/2019/QH14: Working Hours, Rest Periods, and Timekeeping Records (Bộ luật Lao động 2019 - Thời giờ làm việc, thời giờ nghỉ ngơi và chấm công)
notes: Organic legal framework governing labor relations and employee rights in Vietnam: employer obligation to maintain accurate, tamper-evident daily timekeeping records (chấm công) for salary calculation, overtime compensation, and social insurance audits.

title: Circular 28/2020/TT-BGDĐT & Circular 32/2020/TT-BGDĐT: Regulations on Working Regimes and Duty Rosters of Teachers and Staff in General Education
notes: Statutory standards governing teacher workloads, duty shifts, homeroom assignments, administrative management responsibilities, and school faculty attendance records.

title: Decision 4998/QĐ-BGDĐT: Digital Transformation Guidelines for K-12 Educational Management and Staff Timekeeping
notes: National guidelines for digitizing school management systems, establishing electronic attendance rosters, automated time stamps, and operational reporting standards for educational personnel.

title: Functional Specification: Sổ Tay PH (School Parent Handbook & Knowledge Base)
notes: Comprehensive functional specification for Parent Handbook: 2-tier category taxonomy, accordion single-active expansion, rich text composer with attachments, article-centric search pruning, 1-click publish/hide, and cascading deletion modal ST-01.

title: Circular 32/2018/TT-BGDĐT & Circular 22/2021/TT-BGDĐT: Regulations on Transparency of Institutional Charters, Behavioral Codes, and Parental Communication
notes: National educational framework obligating K-12 and pre-K schools to publicly publish institutional regulations, grading rubrics, parent-teacher collaboration protocols, and student rights in durable electronic formats.

title: Decree 13/2023/NĐ-CP: Protection of Personal Data and Student Information in Public Electronic Knowledge Bases
notes: Statutory decree on personal data protection mandating that public knowledge bases and school reference portals contain only institutional guidance and policies without leaking private student or parent data.

title: Functional Specification: Góp Ý (School Parent Feedback & Ticketing Inbox)
notes: Comprehensive functional specification for Parent Feedback & Ticketing: parent-only ticket inception, 4 KPI status cards, 8 feedback categories, 4 color-coded priority levels, turn-taking response states, two-way discussion stream, and guarded closure modal GY-01.

title: Circular 32/2020/TT-BGDĐT: Regulations on Parent-Teacher Representative Committees and Institutional Feedback Channels
notes: Statutory regulations governing parent consultation mechanisms, institutional feedback channels, complaint resolution workflows, and transparent communication protocols between school leadership and families.

title: Decree 13/2023/NĐ-CP: Personal Data Protection in School Feedback Handling and Parent-Student Profiles
notes: National decree mandating data minimization and secure role-based access when displaying student academic details and parent contact data during administrative feedback handling.

title: Functional Specification: Năm Học (School Academic Year & Term Milestones)
notes: Comprehensive functional specification for Academic Year: dynamic determination of 'Hiện tại' badge according to system date, free-form naming, omission of delete functionality, 3-field create/edit form, and real-time client-side search filtering.

title: Decision 2045/QĐ-BGDĐT: Framework for Academic Year Timeframes in Pre-K, General, and Continuing Education (Khung kế hoạch thời gian năm học của Bộ GD&ĐT)
notes: National regulatory framework establishing statutory start dates, end dates, semester milestones, and winter/summer break boundaries across primary, secondary, and high school educational institutions.

title: Circular 32/2020/TT-BGDĐT & Circular 28/2020/TT-BGDĐT: Regulations on Academic Calendars, School Terms, and Educational Evaluation Milestones
notes: Statutory regulations governing school academic year terms, evaluation cycles, student records rollover, and institutional timekeeping across Vietnamese educational institutions.

title: Functional Specification: Lưu Trữ (School Archive & Withdrawn Student Directory)
notes: Comprehensive functional specification for Student Archive: cold-storage directory for withdrawn students, tolerant metadata nullability, student detail modal with yellow warning banner, staff operator profile modal, and distinct confirmation modals for restore (LT-01) and irreversible purge (LT-02).

title: Circular 28/2020/TT-BGDĐT: Primary School Charter on Student Academic Records and Withdrawal/Transfer Retention
notes: Statutory regulations governing student registration, pupil academic transcripts (học bạ), withdrawal retention, transferring procedures, and archival preservation requirements in primary schools.

title: Law on Archives No. 01/2011/QH13: Statutory Regulations on Records Preservation and Secure Disposal in Public and Educational Bodies
notes: National legislative mandate governing the custody, preservation terms, authorized destruction safeguards, and confidentiality of institutional and citizen records.

title: Functional Specification: Trường (School Profile & Operational Baseline Configuration)
notes: Canonical functional specification for School Profile: read-only overview page with edit trigger, two-tab edit screen (Thông tin trường & Giờ hoạt động), inline field validation with TR-01 error, independent sub-form saving for weekdays and attendance thresholds, and TR-02 unsaved changes navigation guard.

title: Circular 32/2020/TT-BGDĐT: Regulations on Secondary, High School and Multi-Level School Charters (School Identity, Address, and Operational Mandates)
notes: National regulatory framework stipulating that school naming, address, administrative contact information, official email, and organizational seals must be maintained accurately and verified under provincial Department of Education records.

title: Labor Code No. 45/2019/QH14 & Educational Work Scheduling Directives (Weekly Operating Hours and Working Day Regimes)
notes: Statutory provisions governing regular working hours, daily schedules, rest intervals, and weekend rest periods in educational institutions (Monday through Saturday operation, with Sunday designated as standard non-operational rest).

title: Functional Specification: Tài Khoản (User & Student Account Management and Role-Based Access Control)
notes: Canonical functional specification for Account Management: two-tab structure (Người Dùng & Học Sinh), multi-role assignment, admin role locking and view-only protection, CSDL Sở state synchronization protection, dedicated email and password change flows, dynamic role-dependent fields (staff functions, management classes, supplementary info), and student login credential administration.

title: Decree No. 13/2023/NĐ-CP on Personal Data Protection and Education Sector Identity Governance
publisher: Government of Vietnam & Ministry of Public Security
notes: National legislative decree mandating strict identity safeguards, role-based access control, cryptographic password storage, dedicated audit trails for email and credential modifications, and data integrity safeguards when synchronizing educational user records with national databases.

title: Circular No. 32/2020/TT-BGDĐT & Circular 28/2020/TT-BGDĐT: Regulations on Educational Staff Roles, Homeroom Management, and Electronic Record Administration
notes: National regulatory framework stipulating institutional staff classifications (Principal, Vice-Principal/Deans, Homeroom Teachers, Subject Teachers, Clerical/Medical Staff) and administrative role assignments in electronic school management portals.

title: Functional Specification: Nhận Diện (Face Recognition Management & Registration Authority)
notes: Canonical functional specification for Face Recognition management: student roster view, registration status filtering, read-only student demographics binding (Biệt danh, Giới tính, Ngày sinh, Lớp học link), disabled submit buttons until file uploaded, current photo preview in edit mode, and explicit student-name delete confirmation dialog.

title: Operational Face Recognition Integration in Attendance & Media Albums Inventory
notes: Inventory audit documenting downstream operational consumers of registered face templates: automated gate and bus attendance check-in/out and automated AI face-recognition tagging of students in uploaded class media albums.

title: Decree No. 13/2023/NĐ-CP on Sensitive Personal Data Protection (Biometric Facial Data Governance in Educational Institutions)
publisher: Government of Vietnam & Ministry of Public Security
notes: Statutory requirements governing processing, storage, purpose limitation, and affirmative erasure mechanisms for sensitive personal biometric data (facial recognition templates) of minors in primary and secondary schools.

title: Functional Specification: Tính Năng (Feature Flags & Academic Term Configuration)
notes: Canonical functional specification for Feature Flags: two-tab two-route structure (/setting/activity/ and /setting/period/), independent toggles for Comments and Moderation, dirty-state Update button, dynamic academic year dropdown with (Hiện tại) default, strict 2-term limit per school year, inline table row editing with tick/X icons, single-row mutual exclusion lock, deletion prohibition on saved terms, and clean empty state.

title: Operating Portal Inventory & Cross-Module Feature Architecture
notes: Inventory audit documenting downstream operational consumers of feature flag settings: class activity comment permissions, approval queue triggers, and academic term boundaries for gradebooks, attendance, and evaluation reports.

title: Circular No. 32/2020/TT-BGDĐT & Decision No. 2045/QĐ-BGDĐT: Regulations on Academic Year Timeframes and Semester Division in Vietnamese Primary and Secondary Schools
notes: National regulatory framework stipulating institutional semester divisions (Học kỳ 1 and Học kỳ 2) within an academic year, minimum instructional weeks (35 weeks), and semester start and conclusion milestones.

title: Functional Specification: Thông Báo (Notification Configuration & System-Wide Broadcast Rules)
notes: Canonical functional specification for Notification Configuration: single monolithic form with unified bottom 'Cập nhật' button, mandatory confirmation modal ('Vui lòng xác nhận thay đổi cấu hình thông báo của trường!'), top policy banner with 31st-day overflow rule, shared birthday time parameter without toggle, dual-channel asymmetry (Web/App and Email for pending activities and daily logs), fixed readonly operational times (17:00 and 20:00), extracurricular class scope dropdown, tuition due reminder timing (Before/After N days), and parent notification action keyword highlights.

title: Operating Portal Inventory & Cross-Module Notification Delivery Architecture
notes: Inventory audit documenting downstream operational consumers of notification settings: automated attendance check-in/out alerts to parents and teachers, birthday greetings dispatch engine, tuition payment deadline and overdue notices, pending moderation queue alerts, daily log notifications, and media album tagging broadcasts.

title: Decree No. 91/2020/NĐ-CP & Decree No. 13/2023/NĐ-CP on Electronic Communications, Operational Notifications, and Guardian Privacy Protection
publisher: Government of Vietnam & Ministry of Information and Communications
notes: Statutory regulations governing institutional electronic notifications, scheduled reminders, opt-in/opt-out configuration mechanisms, multi-channel broadcast parameters, and parent-student relationship notification integrity in educational portals.
